Added: Complete three-act expedition with Reaver, Rogue, Herald and Starseer; nine encounter stops, route choices and three bosses.
Eighteen cards, poison/weakness/strength, cyclic enemy intents, six equipment items, flasks, rest and deck removal.
Campaign JSON record editor, validated CSV interchange, development component gallery and bug-report preview.
Android test APK, per-channel campaign saves with backup, sound feedback, mute and motion settings.

Reused attack, guard and hit poses for all four classes; added impact motion and feedback.
Card descriptions now reflect active strength and equipment bonuses.
Browser automation uses read-only control bounds and observed state changes; PR checks play a full expedition.

Browser checks wait for rendered card selection and record failure screenshots/state.
Added an audio listener when the UI scene has none, preserving an owner-provided listener.
Protected rewards and purchases from duplicate commands; lethal poison prevents retaliation.

Buy an Ember Blade and check card damage increases; use a flask and choose rewards.
Reload during combat, continue, and verify the deck, health, equipment and enemy state.
Try the Android APK or hosted dev page on your phone; report device, browser, version and seed.
